text.tspan: S2 EPS rails and load switches (SQSO-EPS-BRD-001)
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · dashed = part not selected · values from the board build-to designs
All converters synchronised to 1.000 MHz from Y1 (4 MHz XO) / 4 (U62, U63), no spread spectrum (rule E1); the Jetson carrier takes VBAT through U19 (rule E3).
TPS1H100B 2.0 A; eFuse TPS16630 1.20 A latch-off on JETSON_PWR (PA2);
TPS2553 0.30 A, retry 0.28 s; W6B to OBC J6
TPS1H000 0.148 A + F4 0.25 A + Q22 40 C cutout
TPS2553 0.20 A, retry 1.3 s; W9B to OBC J4
TPS2553 1.37 A; AntS I2C via U80
J3-36/39 to the OBC coil bridges
Every enable is low at reset and held low by its pull-down.
SW3's pull-down is mandatory: hardware TX-OFF (BASELINE 7).
TPS2553 rails: current limit in 2 us, FAULT after 8 ms pulls EN
low (R_FAULT 100 k, C_RETRY), so a latch-up power-cycles the rail.
Load shed (U48): VBAT < 13.6 V for 5 s -> SHED_N low -> SW1 and
SW3 off; released above 14.4 V; independent of the OBC.
Rail currents: INA3221 U32-U35 on the EPS controller's bus.
